name: Urborg
description: The swampy region where the Stronghold is located.

timeline.summary: Windgrace sacrifices his life to protect Urborg, first binding his soul to the land and vowing to watch over it.
timeline.quote: He sacrificed his life to protect his home of Urborg, but not before binding his soul to the land and vowing to always watch over it.

relations.note: the Stronghold is built into the volcano on Urborg
relations.quote: It had been created as a Phyrexian base, then had been partially destroyed by an eruption when the Phyrexians were defeated.
